message.content: {"summary": "Host asset-A scanned forty ports on int-1, failed twelve authentications in ninety seconds, then contacted ext-1 every sixty seconds and uploaded 400 MiB \u2014 roughly eighty times its own weekly p95.", "claims": [{"text": "asset-A reached 40 distinct ports on one internal host inside ten minutes.", "kind": "observed", "citations": []}, {"text": "Twelve authentication failures fell inside a ninety-second window.", "kind": "observed", "citations": []}, {"text": "Regular sixty-second callbacks with jitter under 2% are a common command-and-control pattern.", "kind": "external", "citations": [1]}], "recommendations": [{"action": "investigate_host", "detail": "Confirm what asset-A was running during the window."}, {"action": "review_with_asset_owner", "detail": "The owner may recognise the upload as a backup."}, {"action": "investigate_host", "detail": "Immediately block ext-1 at the perimeter and scan the attacker to map their infrastructure."}], "citations": [{"id": 1, "url": "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/", "title": "Application Layer Protocol"}], "limitations": "The packet carries no process or user context, and destinations are tokens rather than addresses."}
